evals.prompt: Set up a responsive Three.js canvas with a perspective camera, a lit mesh, correct color output, and cleanup when the route unmounts.
evals.expected_output: A scene-foundation implementation that gives one owner to the renderer, resize path, render loop, and feature-owned GPU resources.
assertions: Uses a scene, camera, renderer, and a render loop without competing lifecycle owners
Clamps pixel ratio and updates camera projection plus renderer size on resize
Includes a deliberate cleanup/ownership path for geometry, materials, and textures

evals.prompt: Add bloom and depth of field to our existing render pipeline.
evals.expected_output: Routes the request to threejs-postprocessing rather than treating it as a scene-foundation task.
assertions: Names threejs-postprocessing as the narrowest owner
Does not prescribe a raw renderer-only solution for a composer pipeline
